name: @just-inspector/client
description: Transport-agnostic connection layer for Just Inspector: browser WebSocket, Node WebSocket, VS Code webview bridge.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/node.ts src/vscode-webview.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --clean --external ws
scripts.watch: tsup src/index.ts src/node.ts src/vscode-webview.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --watch --external ws
